A stratified epithelium restricted almost exclusively to the urinary tract from the renal calyces to the proximal urethra.

Unusually long, branching, non-motile apical projections supported by an internal actin filament core.
Despite their name, they lack microtubules and basal bodies.

The most apical component of the epithelial junctional complex.
Transmembrane claudin and occludin proteins fuse adjacent outer membrane leaflets into anastomosing sealing strands.

A disc-shaped spot-weld anchoring junction abundant in tissues subjected to mechanical stress such as the epidermis.

A specialized communicating plaque where adjacent plasma membranes are separated by a uniform 2-nanometer cleft.

An asymmetric anchoring junction situated along the basal domain of stratified epithelial cells.

A classic unicellular exocrine gland shaped like a wine glass scattered within columnar epithelia.
